summary: Bind synchronized metadata to the active ScreenCloud organization, purge mirrored API rows on organization changes, and fail closed on Playgrounds data writes until an atomic concurrency precondition is verified.
reason: A credential change must not allow organization-scoped analysis to reuse any rows from another organization. The observed data-write contract has no atomic lastModified or equivalent precondition, so a separate version check cannot make live writes race-free and the CLI must not send them.
validated_outcome: Focused safety tests, the full Go test suite, go vet, go build, and a fresh authenticated read-only dogfood matrix passed (148 evaluated checks, 0 failures); mutation-shaped cases remained dry-run only.
